sloka: स तु दत्त्वा दशग्रीवो वनं घोरं स्वरस्य तत् ।भगिनीं च समाश्वास्य हृष्टः स्वस्थतरो ऽभवत् ।। ७.२५.१ ॥
transliteration: sa tu dattvā daśagrīvo vanaṁ ghoraṁ svarasya tat ।bhaginīṁ ca samāśvāsya hṛṣṭaḥ svasthataro 'bhavat ।। 7.25.1 ॥

translations.english: Having given that terrible forest to Khara and having consoled his sister, Dashagriva became delighted and more at ease.
